scripts.test: pnpm run test:demo && pnpm run test:stories
scripts.lint: oxlint --config oxlint.config.mts tests *.mts playwright*.ts --max-warnings 0 && oxlint --config oxlint.react.config.mts harness src --max-warnings 0
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --config oxlint.config.mts tests *.mts playwright*.ts --max-warnings 0 --fix && oxlint --config oxlint.react.config.mts harness src --max-warnings 0 --fix
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.playwright.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.browser.json
